text: Working with APIs is an important skill for modern developers. An API allows two programs to communicate with each other. Most APIs work through HTTP requests, such as GET to retrieve data or POST to send it. The server usually responds with JSON, a simple text format that is easy to read and parse. Before you can use an API, you often need authentication, for example an API key, to prove who you are. Be careful about rate limits, which restrict how many requests you can make in a certain time. Finally, always add error handling, because requests can fail for many reasons.
